the attainment or success under consideration
compound devatā-yogitā (union with deity) with sandhi before iti; states the reason as reported
introduces a conditional objection or hypothetical claim

items.question: Does worship produce accomplishment because of the practitioner's union with the deity?
premises: Accomplishment may be attributed to worship.
Worship may be said to effect union with a deity.
Union with a deity may be proposed as the cause of accomplishment.
items.inference: If accomplishment arises through worship due to union with the deity, then worship is the effective cause of that accomplishment.
uncertainties: The completion of the conditional clause is implied by the following context rather than stated explicitly.
items.plain_english: If it is objected here that accomplishment comes through worship because of union with the deity—
